Sandbox_Collections_AnthroComics_tooltip:
This option will enable the various anthropomorphic comics popular in the '80s and '90s.

You friggin' bulge nuzzler.
Sandbox_Collections_AnthroComicSpawnRate: Spawn multiplier for the amount of fuzzy wuzzy comics you will find.
Sandbox_Collections_Manga_tooltip:
This option will toggle the various mangas.

You doggone weeaboo paloozer.
Sandbox_Collections_MangaSpawnRate_toolt: Spawn multiplier for the amount of weeb comics you will find.
Sandbox_Collections_ContemporaryComics_t:
This option will adjust the spawnrate of the various comics with dates ranging from the 1970s to early '90s.

Generic comics befit of any upcoming child wishing to immerse themselves in various stories.
Sandbox_Collections_ContemporaryComicsSp: Spawn multiplier for the amount of timeline-recent comics you will find.
Sandbox_Collections_ComicsSection_toolti: This is just a header for this category of collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_VintageComics_toolti:
This option will toggle the vintage comics.

Older comics which may be deemed as quite collectible by any comic geek around.
Sandbox_Collections_VintageComicsSpawnRa: This option will adjust the spawnrate of vintage comics.
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsSection_toolti: This is just a header for this category of collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_Medals_tooltip:
This option will toggle on the collectible medals within the mod.

You'll have to find the Medal Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsSpawnRate_tool: This option will adjust the spawnrate of standard medals.
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsSilly_tooltip:
This option will toggle on the silly and not-at-all lore-accurate medals.

You'll have to find the Medal Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Use at your own discretion!
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsSillySpawnRate: This option will adjust the spawnrate of silly medals.
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsRare_tooltip:
This option will toggle on the medals that may be uncommon to find in the United States.

This can include various foreign medals and rare US awards.

You'll have to find the Medal Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_MedalsRareSpawnRate_:
This option will adjust the spawnrate of rare medals.

You'll have to find the Medal Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_ComicBox_tooltip: This option will toggle on the spawning of comic book boxes around the game world.
Sandbox_Collections_RequiredBooks_toolti:
This option will adjust the spawnrate of various required books.
These are books that are needed to identify certain collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_ComicBoxSpawnRate_to: This option will adjust the spawnrate of comic book boxes.
Sandbox_Collections_CansSection_tooltip: This is just a header for this category of collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_Cans_tooltip:
This option will toggle on vintage tin cans.

You'll have to find the Can Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_CansSpawnRate_toolti:
This option will adjust the spawnrate of tin cans.

You'll have to find the Can Collecting Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_HeadwearSection_tool: This is just a header for this category of collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_Helm_tooltip:
This option will toggle on various military helmets from WWI through the Cold War.

You'll have to find the Military Headgear Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_HelmSpawnRate_toolti: This option will adjust the spawnrate of helmets.
Sandbox_Collections_Hat_tooltip:
This option will toggle on various military headgear of various time periods.

You'll have to find the Military Headgear Guide in order to properly identify them!
Sandbox_Collections_HatSpawnRate_tooltip: This option will adjust the spawnrate of military headwear.
Sandbox_Collections_Starship_tooltip:
This option allows for the M3 Tactical Helmet from Starship Troopers to naturally spawn in the game world.
It is not at all accurate to 1993 which is why it has its own settings.
Sandbox_Collections_StarshipSpawn_toolti: This option will adjust the spawnrate of the M3 Tactical Helmet.
Sandbox_Collections_UniformSection_toolt: This is just a header for this category of collectibles.
Sandbox_Collections_UniformEnable_toolti:
This option will toggle on various military uniforms of various time periods.

This includes jackets, boots, pants, and field kit.
Sandbox_Collections_UniformSpawnRate_too: This option will adjust the spawnrate of military uniforms.
